prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: hero specimen image for an interactive biology app canvas
Primary request: Generate an ultra-realistic 3D animal cell cutaway specimen matching the same premium educational biology app style as a realistic plant-cell museum model.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm ivory studio background (#fbf7ea), no UI, no labels, no text, no watermark, no pointer cursor, no buttons.
Subject: a single isometric 3D animal cell cutaway model, viewed from slightly above at a three-quarter angle. It should look like a tactile physical resin museum model: rounded flexible blue translucent cell membrane with exposed interior and no rigid cell wall.
Required biological structures: large purple nucleus with nucleolus, orange mitochondria with inner cristae folds, purple rough ER surrounding nucleus, coral Golgi apparatus, yellow centrosome/centrioles, many vesicles and ribosomes, blue cytoplasm, white/blue cytoskeleton filaments crossing the cell. Dense layered detail with occlusion and contact shadows.
Material and realism: hyper-detailed 3D render, clay/resin museum model realism, PBR materials, translucent glossy membrane, subtle pores and surface texture, bevels, ambient occlusion, soft global illumination, realistic shadows, crisp edges, high-resolution, physically plausible depth.
Composition: specimen fills most of frame, centered, enough padding for app overlay controls, perspective similar to a realistic isometric 3D model. No labels inside the image.
Style reference: premium biology app / scientific visualization, ultra-realistic, detailed, tactile, colorful but natural, not cartoon, not symbolic, not flat vector, not medical horror.
Avoid: text, labels, UI chrome, arrows, callouts, watermark, logo, microscopic photo grain, flat illustration, simple icon style, oversaturated neon, blurry edges, fantasy objects, people, hands, instruments.
